sources.title: GitHub - MinishLab/model2vec: Fast State-of-the-Art Static Embeddings
sources.snippet: 30/10/2024: We released three new models: potion-base-8M, potion-base-4M, and potion-base-2M. These models are trained using Tokenlearn. Find out more in our blog post. NOTE: for users of any of our old English M2V models, we recommend switching to these new models as they perform better on all tasks.

sources.title: potion-base-8M: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview potion-base-8M is a static embedding model created by minishlab that distills the BGE-base-en-v1.5 sentence transformer into a compact model for extreme speed and low-resource deployment. The model uses the model2vec framework combined with the Tokenlearn training methodology to create static embeddings—meaning each token has a fixed representation rather than context-dependent ...
